description: This file contains the implementation of the MultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain class, which manages multiple stream subscriptions, tracks message counts, handles activation and deactivation, and provides subscription management functionalities in an Orleans-based streaming system.

classes.name: MultipleSubscriptionConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that manages multiple stream subscriptions, tracks messages received, handles activation/deactivation, and provides subscription management functions.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A helper inner class used to count the number of messages received or errors for each subscription.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the activation callback to perform any initialization steps; here, it logs activation.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Sets up a new stream subscription for a specified stream, initializing counters and tracking the handle.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes an existing stream subscription handle, creates a new handle with the same counters, and tracks it.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a stream handle and stops tracking it.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all active subscription handles for a given stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of all current subscription handles with their respective message and error counts.

methods.name: ClearNumberConsumed
methods.description: Resets message and error counts for all tracked subscriptions.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain, causing it to idle.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Logs deactivation reason during grain deactivation.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Processes incoming stream items, increments message counters, and verifies request context.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles exceptions from stream processing, logs them, and increments error counters.
